title: Coin Candidates: XRP, BNB, ONE, DOT
summary: XRP, BNB, ONE and DOT tested on BB-CORE, I-CORE and T-CORE with the bots' own rules and real costs: every year 2020–2026, the owner's stability rule (6–7 winning years, few losing months, low drawdown, small losses and big wins), and what each coin does to today's lineup (profit added against risk added). BB-CORE: XRP worsens, BNB trade-off, ONE trade-off, DOT trade-off; I-CORE: XRP trade-off, BNB improves, ONE trade-off, DOT worsens; T-CORE: XRP worsens, BNB worsens, ONE improves, DOT trade-off. Nothing was switched on. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: A Fifth Coin for BB-CORE and I-CORE
summary: With ZEC gone and ETH on T-CORE only, BB-CORE and I-CORE trade four coins. About 120 markets were tested per bot, including MEXC's stock, index, gold and oil contracts. Under the owners' rule (stability over luck) no new coin qualifies, so both bots stay on SOL, NEAR, ADA and GALA. Closest: DOT on BB-CORE wins 59% of months (more than any kept coin) but deepens the bot's worst drop from 27.4R to 35.1R; BNB on I-CORE loses in 52% of its months but makes the bot steadier (43% → 39% losing months, +464R → +575R, drop 24.1R → 25.7R). No stock, index, gold or oil contract fits. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: ETH on T-CORE
summary: T-CORE started trading ETH live on 12 Nov 2026 in place of ZEC (being delisted). Every year and month of ETH on T-CORE since 2019, the trading-math checks and a comparison with SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA and GALA. ETH made +177R in 132 trades (+1.34R a trade, profit factor 2.79), was positive every year 2020–2026 and lost money in 27 of 82 months. On the same 2022–2026 window it is T-CORE's steadiest coin (first on 11 of 16 measures, shallowest drawdown, no losing year) but not its biggest earner. BB-CORE and I-CORE do not trade ETH. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Replacing ZEC: ETH
summary: ZEC is being delisted. The three bots (BB-CORE, I-CORE, T-CORE), with their exact live rules and real costs, were tested on 45 coins over 7 years, 9 coins over 10 years and the top 100 by market cap. ETH is the best replacement next to SOL, NEAR, ADA and GALA: no coin improves the portfolio more. Nothing fully replaces ZEC (one year, 2025, made +100R): with ETH the portfolio earns about 14% less (+423R vs +490R since Oct 2021) but is smoother (Sharpe 2.03 vs 1.69) and its risk is spread (the 5th coin carries 13% of the risk instead of ZEC's 56%). Backup: BTC. Check ETH's larger MEXC contract size first. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Live Pair vs Three-Bot Mix
summary: The two live bots (BB-CORE + I-CORE, ₱10,000 split 50/50) against 10 other mixes on SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA and GALA, 4h, 2020 to 5 Nov 2026, judged with the trading-math survival checks. The live pair made money in 7 of 7 years and 70% of months, about ₱33,500 a year on a fresh ₱10,000. Adding a third bot, T-CORE, with 25% of the money (TRI-CORE, 50/25/25) keeps the same score before and after 2023 (20.5), cuts the chance of a 30% drop from 55% to 39% and is positive in rising, sideways and falling months. It made less in 2022–2023. Paper-test T-CORE first. ₱60 per $1. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: bb-core 4h vs 1h: Side by Side
summary: The same rules on the same 5 coins on 4-hour and 1-hour candles, with real funding. 1h makes +724R against +594R, but its drawdowns are deeper in most tests (−31.2R against −24.9R) and it has no live record. Includes MEXC candles, data before 2020, the paper test and what switching would take. Recommendation: keep 4h live and decide at the December 4 review. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Finding a Profitable 1-Hour Strategy
summary: 684 variations of 16 indicators on the 1-hour chart over 7 years, and the best on the bots' 5 coins. The pick is bb-core's own logic on 1-hour candles: +724R on 1,585 trades, profitable in 7 of 7 years, ending at ₱1,909,674 from ₱15,750. The trend strategies show larger totals but deep drops and few winners. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: bb-core 1h from ₱1,000: Every Year and Month
summary: The 1-hour version of bb-core on SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA and GALA, starting with ₱1,000 on 1 January 2020. Ends at ₱1,377,148 on 5 November 2026 with a worst drop of −38%, against ₱939,025 for the 4-hour version. Every year and every month, with 2026 in detail. The early years are not realistic at this size. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: bb-core, I-Core and MA Trend: What If the Money Is Split?
summary: SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA and GALA, 4h, 2020 to 5 Nov 2026. The two live bots against the new MA Trend, and ₱15,750 ($250 at ₱63) split equally across them or put all in one: whole period, since 2023, and 2026 month by month, with and without a ₱3,150 cap on the risk per trade. The equal split ends at ₱1,880,947 over the 7 years, between the bots and the MA, with a worst drop of -14%. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: MA Trend Systems on 7 Coins, Year by Year
summary: The first 10 list indicators (SMA to ALMA), built like the bots (200 trend filter, 2 ATR stop, 14 ATR trail, long only), on SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA, GALA, BTC and ETH, 2019 to 5 Nov 2026. Result by year, best coins, fresh ₱10,000 per January at 2.5% risk, against bb-core and I-Core on the same candles. All ten beat both bots in total R, but 2022 loses for every one. Checked bar by bar in the StrategyBacktester replay (no repaint). A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Moving-Average Trend Systems vs bb-core and I-Core
summary: Ten moving averages (SMA to ALMA) on BTC, ETH, SOL and ADA, 4h, Sep 2019 to Nov 2026, plain and rebuilt with a 200 trend filter, ATR stop and wide ATR trail. The tweaked version averages +2.37R per trade against +0.63R (I-Core) and +0.35R (bb-core) and 90% of its settings beat I-Core from 2023 on, but it wins only 20% of trades and earns most of its profit in two years. Per year ₱10,000 results at 2.5% risk. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Three Setups Compared: Fixed Target, No Target and the Second Bot
summary: Five coins, 2020 to Oct 2026. Per trade, ₱10,000 in each year at 2.5% risk, without the best years and trades, on seven coins never used to design the bots, the three pairs of two bots, and the new risk rule (steps down as the account grows, no cap). The first bot with no target averages +0.45R per trade against +0.33R with the fixed target; the second bot +0.87R but 74% of its profit is ten trades. The no-target version is not live yet. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: The two bots: Trades, Monthly Profit and ₱10,000 Results

How many trades each bot takes every month, the busiest months and days, how many months make or lose money at the bots' own settings, and what ₱10,000 becomes at the live 2.5% risk: fresh each January, compounding every trade or every month. Before any fee. A test on past prices, not a promise.
